_comment: research-notes scaffold -- EXAMPLE config (a template to adapt, not a live
config). Copy the models block into your own config (~/.jichi or
local/config.json) and fill in your provider/model/apiBase. Secret-free:
the key comes from an env var named by apiKeyEnv, never a literal key here.
A capable chat model is all you need. Point at a local model (LM Studio /
llama.cpp / Ollama) or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; see docs/LOCAL_MODELS.md.
This bench helps you READ and ORGANIZE research; it does not read for you.
Keep source ideas separate from your own in your notes, and cite everything.
The optional embed model powers @docs / search over your notes if you index
them; delete it if unused. snapshots let you /undo; pathFence keeps writes
